import numpy as np
def read(f):
    lines=open(f).read().split('\n')
    n=int(lines[0]); els=[];xyz=[]
    for l in lines[2:2+n]:

e1,a1=read('embed3d.xyz'); e2,a2=read('answer.xyz')
def kabsch(P,Q):
    Pc=P-P.mean(0); Qc=Q-Q.mean(0)
    H=Pc.T@Qc
    U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(H)
    d=np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T))
    D=np.diag([1,1,d])
    R=Vt.T@D@U.T
    return R
R=kabsch(a1,a2)
a1r=(a1-a1.mean(0))@R.T+a2.mean(0)
d=np.linalg.norm(a1r-a2,axis=1)
print("aligned max disp:", d.max(), "rmsd:", np.sqrt((d**2).mean()))
